title: Neural Net Playground
blurb: Drop red and blue dots and watch a tiny neural network learn to tell them apart, live.

title: Fourier Draw
blurb: Draw any shape with your finger, then watch spinning circles redraw it. That's a Fourier series.

title: Double Pendulum Chaos
blurb: Start two pendulums a tiny 0.001° apart and watch them end up doing totally different things.

title: Gradient Descent Hill
blurb: Drop a ball on a hilly landscape and watch it roll to the bottom. It's how AI learns, one small step at a time.

title: Boids Flocking
blurb: Hundreds of birds following just three simple rules. Watch a flock appear out of nothing.

title: Gravity Sandbox
blurb: Fling planets and stars around and watch them orbit, slingshot and crash. Real Newtonian gravity.

title: Ripple Tank
blurb: Tap the water to make waves. Build walls and slits and watch the waves interfere, just like light.

title: Fractal Zoom
blurb: Dive into the Mandelbrot set. Zoom forever into shapes that never repeat, then jump to matching Julia sets.
